settings.headline: Grown in soil, not in a lab.
settings.copy: We farm 42 acres the way food is supposed to be grown — rotating pastures, cover crops, and compost instead of chemical shortcuts. Every box we deliver is harvested that morning, so what lands on your table is a few hours from the field, not a few weeks from a warehouse.

settings.title: Four honest steps,
settings.intro: Here's exactly how your food gets from Meadowrest to your table — and why you can taste the difference in the very first bite.

steps.title: Sow & rotate
steps.text: Every field follows a multi-year rotation that rebuilds soil rather than depleting it. Cover crops and compost feed the ground so the plants feed you.

steps.title: Grow, the slow way
steps.text: No synthetic inputs, no forced ripening. Crops mature on their own schedule, which is why our tomatoes taste like tomatoes and our corn tastes like corn.

steps.title: Harvest at dawn
steps.text: Boxes are picked the morning of delivery — vegetables still carrying field dew, eggs gathered within the hour, grains milled in small batches.

steps.title: Deliver same-day
steps.text: Your harvest box goes from field to kitchen within the day. What you don't eat fresh, you freeze knowing exactly where it came from.

settings.note: Meadowrest is built on transparency: visit any time, walk the fields, and ask us what's growing. We'll show you the soil, the seed, and the whole honest chain.

settings.title: Real food,
settings.intro: Organic isn't a label we buy — it's a method we practice every day. Here's what actually happens on our farm, and why it matters for your family's table.

features.title: Certified, not just claimed
features.text: Third-party certified organic since 2011, with every field, crop, and input documented and inspected — not a marketing word on a label.

features.title: Soil-first farming
features.text: We grow the soil, not just the crop. Compost, cover crops, and rotation build the biology that makes our vegetables deep in flavor and nutrition.

features.title: Pasture-raised, truly
features.text: Our hens range on fresh pasture daily, rotated onto new ground each week. The eggs taste the difference — richer yolks, cleaner flavor.

features.title: Heritage, not hybrid
features.text: We grow open-pollinated and heritage varieties chosen for flavor and resilience, not shipping shelf life — so the produce is unforgettable.

features.title: Delivered same-day
features.text: Boxes are packed and delivered the same morning they're harvested, skipping the cold-storage weeks most supermarket produce endures.

features.title: Know your farmer
features.text: We answer every question honestly — the good, the weather-dependent, and the occasionally awkward. No faceless supply chain here.

settings.title: What our
settings.intro: We asked a few of the 340 households on our weekly box what changed when they started eating from the farm. Their answers were about taste, trust, and knowing where dinner comes from.

reviews.quote: I grew up on my grandparents' farm, and the first tomato I got from Meadowrest tasted like a memory I'd almost lost. You can't buy that in a grocery store, no matter the price.
reviews.author: Daniel R.

reviews.quote: The eggs are unreal — rich yolks, no comparison to store-bought. And I love that I can visit, see the fields, and meet the people who grow my family's dinner.
reviews.author: Elena V.

reviews.quote: We tried a dozen CSAs before this one. Meadowrest is the only farm that tells you the honest truth about what's in season and what's not, then delivers it better than promised.
reviews.author: Marcus B.
